description: Defines a template class 'base_resumable_procedure' for managing resumable tasks that are not coroutines, including methods for starting, resuming, awaiting, and completing asynchronous procedures. Also defines a type alias 'async_procedure' for non-coroutine resumable tasks.

classes.name: base_resumable_procedure
classes.description: A template class managing resumable, non-coroutine asynchronous tasks, providing mechanisms for starting, resuming, awaiting, and completing tasks.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Resumes or starts the resumable procedure based on coroutine frame state.

methods.name: async_await
methods.description: Handles awaiting an Awaitable object within the resumable procedure.

methods.name: async_return
methods.description: Completes the procedure with a void return.

methods.name: async_return
methods.description: Completes the procedure with a non-void return value.

methods.name: final_await
methods.description: Handles final suspension and cleanup after task completion.

methods.name: await_resume_helper
methods.description: Processes the result of an Awaitable that returns a value.

methods.name: await_resume_helper
methods.description: Processes the result of an Awaitable that returns void.
